response.original_title: Nous les cheminots : Quand un peuple se met debout
response.overview: 1995. France experiences one of the largest social movements in its history. For several weeks, railway workers mobilise en masse against the government’s reforms. This historic mobilisation would leave a lasting mark on the railway sector and on French social history. ‘We, the Railway Workers: When a People Rise Up’ looks back at the strikes of November and December 1995 through the testimonies of those who lived through them. Through a blend of memories, archive footage and personal accounts, this documentary plunges us into the heart of a mobilisation that shaped an entire generation. More than 30 years on, what remains of this struggle? How did the railway workers organise themselves? And what lessons can we learn from this historic movement today?
